test_cases.name: Verbose Multi-Item Quote Request with Ambiguous T-Shirt Reference
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, including a T-Shirt line that is ambiguous due to multiple matching catalog entries. The request includes detailed context and a mix of item reference styles.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Multiple Items for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are preparing for our upcoming spring promotion and would like to request a detailed sales quote for several products that we plan to feature. Please see the list below for the items and quantities we are interested in. If you need any further information, feel free to reach out.

1. Generic Golden T-Shirt – 50 units. This is for our staff uniforms, so please ensure these are the golden variant as shown in your catalog.
2. T-Shirt – 100 units. We need standard T-Shirts for giveaways, but I noticed there are several T-Shirts listed in your catalog. Please quote for the regular T-Shirt (not the golden one), but I am not sure which specific model number applies, so please use the one most commonly ordered for events.
3. Rasta Coffee Grinder (AITEM-0027) – 10 pieces. These are intended as prizes for our coffee tasting booth.
4. Soda - Large – 200 bottles. Please confirm if these are available for delivery by the end of next month.
5. AdventureCraft Building Blocks – 25 sets. These will be included in our family activity packs.

We are aiming for delivery by the last week of next month, if possible. If there are any minimum order requirements or special pricing for bulk quantities, please include that information in your quote. Thank you for your assistance and attention to detail.

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

5. Mango (Item No: AITEM-0072) – 75 kg. Please confirm if these are currently in season.

Best regards,
Fresh Foods North Europe
